title: Verified iOS builds
description: The iOS builds on which Paneport's JIT request protocol has been verified (C-0006 section 6). The app ships the list and warns on a build that it does not hold, but still runs. tools/CheckCompat.cs validates compat/ios-builds.json against this schema, and adds two rules that a schema cannot state: a build and a model appear together once, and every evidence record exists.

schemaVersion.description: Currently 1. A required field, or a field removed or renamed, raises it.

builds.description: One entry for each iOS build and device model on which the protocol was verified.

iosVersion.description: The iOS version as Settings shows it, such as 26.1 or 26.0.1.

iosBuild.description: The iOS build, such as 23B85: two digits, a capital letter, digits, and a lower-case letter for some builds.

deviceModel.description: The device model identifier, such as iPhone18,1 for an iPhone 17 Pro. Never the device's name (C-0012 section 4).

evidence.description: The evidence records that verified this build on this model, oldest first: L3's, and then the phase 1 gate's, which adds its record to the same entry (C-0012 sections 3 and 4).
